args.title: Ironbark Tooling: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 — summary
args.body:
- Ironbark Tooling's latest newsletter covers cold-chain logistics in 2026, linking to their article and companion piece on the topic.
- The article reports temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data, with most savings coming from fewer rejected loads rather than less spoilage.
- The companion piece finds that pilot programs cut claims by a quarter.
